tests.name: combined_repository_suite_with_official_ibkr_sdk
tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src:<authorized-ibkr-sdk-site-packages> python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -q

tests.name: combined_repository_suite_without_optional_sdk_import_path
tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -q

tests.name: focused_ibkr_callback_and_reporting_suite
tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src:<authorized-ibkr-sdk-site-packages> python3.12 -B -m unittest tests.test_live_ibkr_runtime tests.test_live_ibkr_read tests.test_live_ibkr_instrument_preflight tests.test_live_local_assembly

tests.name: repository_validator
tests.scope: executable source commit and built release artifacts before adding this report/evidence pair

tests.name: compile_and_diff_checks
tests.command: python3.12 -B -m compileall -q src scripts && git diff --check
